reason: I'm two waiters short, so if guests can settle the bill themselves it saves my people the running back and forth with the terminal. Three months free means I can test it without risking my money, but I'm only taking the free trial and I'll decide on the 59 GEL after that.
objection: Most of my guests here hand over a card or cash and wait for the waiter. I don't believe many will pay by QR, and if my manager has to match these payments against Wox by hand every night, it's one more system, not less work.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free months less than a fifth of tables pay by QR, or it doesn't line up with my POS without manual work, I cancel. If it closes bills straight into my POS, I'd pay without thinking.
